verdict.rationale: The evidence documents alerting on log patterns, counts, and attribute values, plus an AI 'Tune a Noisy Alert' use case. None of it describes anomaly or outlier detection that works without hand-set thresholds. Anomaly detection is a fair question for an observability platform, so the absence of evidence is 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can enable anomaly or outlier detection that surfaces problems without hand-written thresholds
